items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: And they had, uh, Henry Martin, snare drum.

ctx.x: Did he play E flat? You remember?
No, he played B flat. Respectful B flat. All low pitch. Low pitch. And they had, they had Arthur Alexander, citrophone. And they had, uh, Henry Martin, snare drum.
